units.hook: Most people are never told what dentures do to the jaw.
units.body: A denture sits on the gums. It does not replace the root, so the jaw can change shape and the denture loosens. An implant is fixed in the bone. Tom Szarski, DD, and Dr. Alex look at that on a 3D scan during a free consultation.
units.spoken: A denture sits on the gums. It does not replace the root, so the jaw can change shape and the denture loosens. An implant is fixed in the bone. Tom Szarski, DD, and Dr. Alex look at that on a 3D scan during a free consultation.
units.grounding: Adapted from Gemini hook 1. Facts used: free consultation, 3D scan, onsite lab, Tom Szarski DD, Dr. Alex, Orléans.

units.hook: Same-day teeth are a temporary bridge, not the final one.
units.body: In many cases you leave the same day with a fixed temporary bridge. The final teeth are made in the onsite lab after the implants have healed. A 3D scan shows whether that path is the safer one.
units.spoken: In many cases you leave the same day with a fixed temporary bridge. The final teeth are made in the onsite lab after the implants have healed. A 3D scan shows whether that path is the safer one.

units.hook: Hiding a loose denture is not the only plan.
units.body: If you choose meals around what will not slip, a fixed implant bridge stays in. No adhesive. No glass on the nightstand. The quiz is about two minutes and nine questions.

units.hook: Fixed teeth stay in. A denture comes out at night.
units.body: Implants are anchored in the jaw. You brush them. You do not take them out at night. Whether that is right for you depends on bone, gums, and health.
units.spoken: Implants are anchored in the jaw. You brush them. You do not take them out at night. Whether that is right for you depends on bone, gums, and health.

units.hook: A denture slips when the jaw no longer matches it.
units.body: Bone loss changes the shape under a denture. An implant is fixed to the bone, so it does not rely on suction or glue. Outcomes vary. The scan shows your starting point.

units.hook: A bridge files down the teeth beside the gap.
units.body: A traditional bridge needs the neighbouring teeth to be reduced. An implant replaces the missing tooth without grinding them. For a full arch, All-on-4 uses a few implants to hold a whole set of teeth.
units.spoken: A traditional bridge needs the neighbouring teeth to be reduced. An implant replaces the missing tooth without grinding them. For a full arch, All-on-4 uses a few implants to hold a whole set of teeth.
